title: SRE oncall scratchpad - 2026-03-15
content:
Morning notes (handover):
- Handover from Lena at 07:30: quiet overnight except for a single warning spike on embed-prod (~02:10) due to transient infra noise, resolved by itself.

Incidents today:
1) 03:22 AM - pager: api-prod text-gen 95th latency spike (alert: TOKEN-LAT-95 > 1.2s for 5m)
   - Symptoms: sudden jump in 95th and p99 for text-generation endpoints across us-east-1 cluster. Error rate low, but latencies up.
   - Immediate actions taken:
     * SSH to inference-gpu-3, checked top/htop, dmesg - no OOM, no kernel panics.
     * Checked autoscaler events: autoscaler attempted scale-up but failed to attach new GPUs (error: quota-exceeded).
     * Temporarily routed traffic to fallback model variant (gpt-small-quant) via routing policy - latency back within SLO.
     * Notified infra on-call (Priya) to check quota / cloud provider activity.
   - Root cause (initial): autoscaler failed to add instances due to cloud quota mismatch; combined with workload spike (prefetch/large-batch job) which saturated existing GPU pool.
   - Follow-ups (assigned):
     * JIRA-SRE-4521 (assigned to Priya) - investigate quota drift and create runbook step to verify available capacity before autoscaler decisions.
     * Add temporary guard to routing policy to prevent single large-batch jobs from consuming entire pool (action: Noah).
     * Add metric: autoscaler_attach_failures count and alert when >1 in 10m (owner: Michael).

2) 10:05 AM - paging: logging-ingest partial backlog (alert: logging_ingest_backlog > 100k for 15m)
   - Symptoms: ingestion lag for logs pipeline; SQS queue depth increased, downstream worker errors due to rate limits.
   - Actions:
     * Scaled up logging-workers by manual override (policy: +3 workers) to drain backlog.
     * Investigated source: customer X was replaying traffic (internal job), causing surge. Contacted CS/Account to coordinate.
   - Follow-ups:
     * Add a soft quota and backpressure to new customer replay jobs (ticket created: ACCT-993).
     * Update runbook section for logging pipeline: include steps for manual scale and how to identify customer replays.

Runbook TODOs / notes to update:
- autoscaler-runbook.md:
  * Add pre-check step: verify cloud quota (GPUs and instance types) via cloud-quota API before scale decisions.
  * Add recovery step: if attach fails, trigger immediate routed-fallback and open incident with infra.
  * Add playbook subsection for model-variant fallback testing (how to simulate, rollback steps).

- logging-runbook.md:
  * Add instructions to identify customer replays (S3 / ingestion job patterns) and how to coordinate with CS.
  * Document manual scale commands and safe limits.

Action items (personal):
- [ ] Create JIRA-SRE-4521 with detailed repro notes + logs (incl autoscaler logs) - due 2026-03-16.
- [ ] Add prometheus alert for autoscaler_attach_failures and dashboard panel (owner: Michael).
- [ ] Update autoscaler-runbook.md with pre-check steps and emergency fallback (draft + PR) - target 2026-03-17.
- [ ] Coordinate with Noah to implement batch-job limits for heavy prefetch requests - create spec doc.
- [ ] Quick smoke test for model routing fallback in staging (runbook test) - schedule for 2026-03-16 14:00.

Misc troubleshooting notes / commands used:
- checked autoscaler logs: gcloud logging read "resource.type=compute_instance AND logName=projects/redwood/logs/autoscaler" --limit 500 --project=redwood-prod
- grep for attach errors: grep -i "attach" autoscaler.log | tail -n 50
- manual fallback: curl -X POST https://admin-api.redwood/v1/routing/override -d '{"route":"text-gen","variant":"gpt-small-quant"}' (use admin key)

Handover notes for next oncall (Priya will take the 18:00-02:00 shift):
- Key things to watch: autoscaler_attach_failures, 95th latency on text-gen, logging_ingest_backlog.
- Current open tickets: JIRA-SRE-4521 (autoscaler/quota), ACCT-993 (customer replay).
- Deferred items: deeper investigation into cloud quota alerts (not urgent if fallback working) and runbook PRs.

Questions / unresolved:
- Why did cloud quota drift? automated process or manual request? need billing/infra logs.
- Should we add a hard cap to batch size at the ingress layer? pros/cons - discuss with product.

Logs & links:
- Link to autoscaler logs: https://console.cloud/stackdriver/projects/redwood/logs/autoscaler?filter=attach
- Incident slack thread: slack://channel-thread/C02ABCD3/1623456789
- Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/SRE-4521

Notes to self: keep the fallback policy simple and tested. Add one-liner in runbook: "On attach failure, route 100% to compatible variant and notify infra immediately."

End of day quick summary (to include in daily oncall digest):
- Resolved 95th-latency incident by routing fallback and manual scale; root cause autoscaler failed due to quota.
- Drained logging backlog with manual worker scale; customer replay identified as source.
- Created follow-up tickets and runbook updates assigned.
plain_text_preview: 03:22AM pager: api-prod text-gen latency spike - autoscaler attach failed (quota). routed fallback, assigned JIRA-SRE-4521; add alert for attach failures. 10:05AM logging backlog due to customer replay - manual scale, ACCT-993 created. Runbook updates queued.
